title: Ed bann tipti zanfan avek zot lemosion – Nivo 1

blocks.text: Seki ou pou pratike
Remark seki enn zanfan bizin aster, mem si li ti kapav fer mem zafer yer.
Swazir kan pou ede, kan pou atann ek kan pou ansegne.
Enn zanfan bizin led apre ki so latour tonbe

Latour Amira, kat an, tonbe. Li pous bann blok ater: “Mo pa kapav!” Adilt-la verifye sekirite, fer enn tigit lespas ek asiz pre: “Sa finn tonbe. To finn travay dir. Mo kapav res isi.” Leson konstriksion-la kapav atann.

Ko-regilasion vedir ed enn zanfan dan enn moman kot enn lemosion difisil pou li, avek enn adilt kalm ki donn rekonfor, led pratik ouswa sanz enn sitiasion difisil. Oto-regilasion vedir aprann zer so bann lemosion, so latansion ek so bann aksion. Bann zanfan bizin led pandan ki zot pe aprann, sirtou kan zot fatige ouswa boulverse.
Remark seki finn arive avan ou devinn kifer

“Amira finn pous bann blok ater” dekrir seki ou finn trouve. “Amira pe fer difisil” se enn zizman. Enn zanfan trankil kapav boulverse; enn zanfan ki bouze boukou kapav alez. Demann ansegnan-la seki abitie pou li. Enn sel insidan pa kapav montre lakoz, donn enn diagnostik ouswa dir kouma lavi dan so fami ete.
Donn led ki al avek sa zanfan-la

Bann pratik koumans depi 12 mwa. Sa bann group laz-la ed ou prepare; zot pa bann test pou gete seki enn zanfan sipoze kapav fer. Enn andikap, fason kominike, lafatig ek lexperyans konte osi. Swiv plan zanfan-la ek res dan ou rol.

Depi 12 mwa ziska avan 18 mwa: propoz rekonfor, verifye bann swen ki li bizin ek montre enn aksion. Remark kan li avans so lame, montre avek ledwa, fer bann son ouswa pous enn zafer. Pa atann enn explikasion ni enn fason presi pou marse ouswa koze.
Depi 18 mwa ziska avan 3 an: servi bann mo, sign ouswa enn lobze ki li kone ek ed li avek enn letap. Konn enn reg pa vedir kapav swiv li tousel kan li boulverse.

3–6 an, bann zanfan sis an osi: esey bann ti zistwar, bann mo pou bann lemosion ouswa rezourd enn ti problem ansam kan zanfan-la kapav partisipe. Li kapav ankor bizin led direk dan enn lasal bien okipe.

Inklir bann zanfan ki ena enn andikap ek bann zanfan nerodiverzan. “Nerodiverzan” dekrir bann diferans dan fason enn dimounn panse, aprann ouswa konpran linformasion, kouma pou bann zanfan otis. Demann seki ed sa zanfan-la; pa devinn zis apartir enn nom ouswa enn kategori.
Kat diferan travay pou adilt-la
Avan enn moman difisil: diminie letan pou atann ouswa kantite dimounn ansam. Montre seki pou vini apre. Pratik enn aksion itil pandan enn zwe kot zanfan-la alez.
Pandan ki li boulverse: verifye sekirite, bann swen neseser ek si kapav ena douler ouswa maladi. Propoz ou prezans ek rann travay-la pli fasil. Led pa depann lor zanfan-la dir bon mo.
Apre: verifye si li alez ouswa blese. Propoz enn fason fasil pou retourn zwe. Res trankil pa touletan vedir li pare pou koze.
Pli tar: montre enn aksion itil, kouma demann led. Ed pou repar seki neseser, kouma rekonstrir, ek get seki bann adilt kapav sanze prosenn fwa.
Sa bann-la se bann swa pou adilt-la, pa bann letap ki tou zanfan bizin swiv. Enn danze grav, enn posib ka medikal irzan ouswa enn inkietid lor proteksion zanfan bizin bann letap lekol deswit.
Fer atansion ar ou prop repons

Si ou lavwa koumans vinn sek, ralanti ou prosenn fraz. Demann led: “Eski to kapav vey group-la? Mo pou res avek Amira.” Atann ki koleg-la dakor avan li pran rele. Demann ansegnan-la lor bann poz ek bann konsey pratik osi.
Si bizin, koriz ou prop erer: “Mo lavwa ti tro for. Mo pou koz pli dousman.” Zanfan-la pa bizin rekonfort ou. Enn adilt ki res stab ede, me li pa kapav fer tou zanfan santi zot pli bien deswit.
Enn lexanp: ed Amira retourn zwe

Kan Amira montre lintere ankor, adilt-la propoze: “Enn blok ansam, ouswa enn poz?” Li atann olye li rekonstrir tou pou li. Si Amira ankor pe lans bann blok, li gard reg sekirite-la kler: “Bann blok res anba pou personn pa blese,” ek rod led dapre bann letap lekol si neseser.

Pli tar, pandan enn zwe kot Amira alez, adilt-la montre kouma demann led ouswa fer enn baz pli larz pou latour-la. Mem si Amira ti konstrir tousel yer, sa pa prouve ki li kapav debrouy li tousel zordi.
Aster, esey oumem
Dir seki ou finn trouve ek tande, san devinn kifer Amira finn azir koumsa.
Dir enn koleg seki ou ti pou verifye pou sekirite. Pratik ou bann premie mo ek atann enn moman. Pa zwe enn senn kot ou lans bann zafer ouswa azir agresivman.
Propoz enn ti letap pou retourn zwe. Apre dekrir enn zafer ki ou kapav ansegn pli tar. Dir kisannla vey lezot zanfan.
Verifye ou repons
Ou prezans ek enn pli ti prosenn letap al avek sa moman difisil-la. Enn long leson konstriksion kapav atann. Demann ansegnan-la led si ou pa sir kouma gard sekirite ouswa vey tou dimounn.
Ki ti pou sanze pou enn zanfan pli zenn?

Imani, 14 mwa, detourn li kan larive dan lekol fer boukou tapaz. Propoz rekonfor ki li kone, verifye bann swen neseser, diminie bann son ek montre enn letap. Kontrerman ar Amira, personn pa atann li koz lor bann lemosion ouswa enn plan konstriksion. Toulede bizin led ki al avek zot aster.
Seki ou pou pratike
Montre enn zanfan seki pou vini apre avek enn zimaz ouswa enn lobze ki li deza kone.
Rann enn routinn bien okipe pli fasil ek propoz enn plas pli trankil avek enn adilt pre.
Koumans avek moman difisil dan lazourne

Kan ler pou ranze, bann zanfan rasanble kot letazer-la ek bann sez fer tapaz. Enn zanfan kouver so zorey ek rekile. Fer mwins zanfan al kot letazer-la ek aret tapaz bann sez pre: “Ena tapaz. Nou kapav atann isi ansam.” Gete si li paret pli alez ouswa li kapav montre seki li bizin.
Montre seki pou vini apre

Demann ansegnan-la ki bann sign, zimaz ouswa laparey pou kominike zanfan-la servi. Demann seki fami-la kone atraver fason lekol abitie kominike. Enn nouvo zimaz kapav pa vedir nanye pou li. Servi enn zafer ki li kone, kouma so sak ouswa enn foto so prop krose pou sak.
Montre enn letap pandan ki ou fer li: montre foto sak-la ek dir, “Sak isi.” Ede si bizin. Zanfan-la pa bizin montre avek ledwa ouswa reponn enn kestion avan.
Montre ki letap-la fini, apre montre seki vremem vini apre. Ou kapav bouz zimaz-la. Repet sa dan bann routinn toulezour pou zanfan-la aprann lien-la.

Dir zanfan-la kan plan-la sanze. Si lapli anpes zwe dan zardin, ranplas sa zimaz-la avek enn zimaz ki li kone pou zwe andan: “Lapli zordi. Nou pe zwe isi.” Montre li kot. Li kapav ankor santi li desi.

“Aster/apre” montre seki pe arive aster ek seki vini apre. Sa pa zame vedir “gagn manze ouswa rekonfor an rekonpans”. Donn delo, manze, led pou al twalet, kominikasion, rekonfor ek mouvman neseser kan bizin. Demann ansegnan-la led pou bann swen ki difisil.
Fer enn plas pli trankil bienveni ek an sekirite

Montre plas-la dan enn moman kot zanfan-la alez: “To kapav asiz isi avek mwa kan ena boukou dimounn.” Verifye avek ansegnan-la kisannla res pre, kisannla vey group-la ek ki fer si enn dimounn deza pe servi plas-la. Bann adilt bizin trouv zanfan-la; li bizin kapav sorti ek servi so led pou bouze. Verifye si bann zafer al avek so laz, si ena bann ti pies ouswa lezot danze. Repo ek somey bizin bann dispozision lekol finn aprouve.

Propoze: “Pli trankil isi, ouswa mo kapav res pre twa.” Si zanfan-la reste, diminie tapaz ouswa lafoul kot li ete kan li sir pou fer sa. Pa anferm li, pa les li tousel ek pa demann li demann pardon, fer enn lexersis respirasion ouswa atann enn timer avan li sorti. Demann ansegnan-la kouma sanz bann aktivite ki li souvan bizin kite.

Tapaz, lalimier, kontak ek mouvman pa santi parey pou sak zanfan. Enn zanfan kapav pe ekoute pandan ki li balanse ouswa get enn lot kote. Les bann mouvman ki pa fer ditor; pa obliz kontak fizik ouswa get dan lizie. Bann ti sanzman sinp pa bizin enn diagnostik. Demann konsey avan ou servi enn lekipman ouswa enn tretman spesialize.
Bann pli tipti bizin swen pratik osi

Depi 12 mwa ziska avan 18 mwa, verifye plan swen-la, manze, repo, kous, rekonfor ek si kapav ena douler ouswa maladi. Detourn li ouswa pous enn zwe akote kapav vedir “enn poz”. Aret bann parol ouswa zwe anplis, propoz rekonfor ek obzerve. Enn sel aksion pa prouve lakoz.

Swiv ou formasion aprouve pou swen, kouma port enn zanfan, lasante ek somey. Pa souk enn zanfan zame ek pa kouver so figir. Si ou santi ou depase, demann enn lot adilt pran rele ek atann so lakor kler. Sa formasion-la pa ansegn kouma port, nouri ouswa fer dormi enn zanfan. Rod led lasante si zanfan-la boulverse dan enn nouvo fason ouswa enn fason ki trakase ou.
Enn lexanp: Leo kan ler pou ranze

Leo, trwa an, kouver so zorey kan bann sez fer tapaz. Bann zanfan rasanble kot bann letazer. Li rekile ek asize. Li servi sirtou bann sign pou kominike. Sa bann zafer ki nou finn trouve la pa dir nou si li ena enn andikap ouswa enn problem lasante.
Adilt-la demann enn koleg amenn group-la dan prosenn aktivite ek atann so lakor. Li res pre Leo san kole ar li ek dir: “Ena tapaz. Nou kapav atann isi.” Group-la avanse ek tapaz bann sez arete.
Kan Leo montre lintere, adilt-la montre panye ki li kone: “Enn blok isi.” Li montre prosenn aktivite-la. Leo kapav gagn led, gete ouswa pran enn poz. Li pa bizin nom enn lemosion avan.
Avan prosenn ler ranze, ansegnan-la organiz mwins zanfan kot letazer-la. Personel servi mem panye ki Leo kone ek gete si li kapav montre seki li bizin ek al dan prosenn aktivite alez.
Aster, esey avek enn koleg, ouswa dir toulede rol for
Dekrir seki finn rann ler ranze difisil. Dir seki ou ti pou sanz an premie ek ki adilt ti pou vey group-la.
Montre enn lobze ouswa zimaz ki zanfan-la kone, dir letap-la ek montre seki vini apre. Apre, imazinn ki letazer-la bloke: montre vre lezot swa ki ena.
Ou partner montre sign poz ki zanfan-la abitie servi. Montre kot zot kapav pran enn poz ansam ek ki ou ti pou fer si sa plas-la deza okipe.
Verifye ou repons

Eski ou finn diminie tapaz ouswa lafoul? Eski lobze ouswa zimaz-la ti montre vre prosenn letap-la? Eski led ek enn adilt pou veye ti disponib? Demann ansegnan-la lor bann sign ki ou pa kone ouswa si kisannla veye pa kler. Parti 6 montre kouma ekrir ek reget sa plan-la.

modules.title: Ede avan ki moman-la vinn pli difisil

blocks.text: Seki ou pou pratike
Remark bann premie sign ki enn zanfan bizin led ek servi enn premie repons kourt.
Fer sir ki kan enn zanfan demann led ouswa enn poz, enn adilt vremem ed li.
Remark enn sanzman dan sa zanfan-la

Kan li arive, enn zanfan ki abitie koz boukou vinn silansie. Pa krwar otomatikman ki li alez. Enn lot zanfan kapav repet bann kestion ouswa bouz pli vit. Konpar avek so konportman abitie. Verifye danze, douler, maladi ek bann swen neseser an premie. Demann ansegnan-la si ou pa sir.
Esey enn premie repons sinp
Fer sir ki enn dimounn vey group-la. Servi sign led ki zot finn dakor si bizin. Enn adilt koz avek zanfan-la; lezot ed bann zanfan otour.
Sanz enn zafer ki rann moman-la difisil: mwins dimounn pre, mwins parol, mwins letan pou atann ouswa enn pli ti travay.
Apros san fer zanfan-la sote ek san blok li. Ou kapav dir: “Sa finn sanze. Mo kapav res isi.” Propoz enn zafer ki ou vremem kapav fer, apre atann.
Get si li reponn avek enn mouvman, enn sign, enn zimaz, enn laparey ouswa bann mo. Zanfan-la kapav bizin letan pou konpran. Plis kestion kapav rann sa pli difisil.
Si ou propozision azout presion, servi mwins mo ouswa donn plis lespas pandan ki ou res disponib. Si danze ogmante, apel bann dimounn forme ki plan sekirite lekol deziye.

Ou kapav dir: “Sa paret bien agasan,” san dir ki ou kone exakteman kouma zanfan-la santi li. Fer zis bann promes vre: “Mo la ek mo pe rod led.” Konpran enn lemosion pa fer bles enn dimounn vinn akseptab. Gard bann reg sekirite neseser kourt ek kler.
Si zanfan-la pa anvi ou propozision

Enn tipti zanfan pous ou lebra. Aret kontak ki ou ti pe propoze: “Pa enn kallin. Mo kapav asiz isi.” Li kapav ankor anvi ou prezans. Pa zame demann kontak fizik, get dan lizie, fer enn lexersis respirasion, nom enn lemosion ouswa koze avan ou ede. Si enn aktivite ki li kone pa ede, esey mwins parol, plis lespas ouswa enn lot led ki li kone. Parti 4 explik enn lexersis respirasion dous ki bann zanfan preskoler kapav swazir si zot interese; li pa zame enn kondisyon pou gagn swen.
Fer demann led vremem servi enn zafer

AAC se bann inisial pou “augmentative and alternative communication”: bann fason pou kominike ansam avek ouswa dan plas laparol. Sa kapav inklir bann zes, bann sign ki zanfan-la kone, montre bann zimaz avek ledwa, enn liv pou kominike ouswa enn laparey ki koze kan zanfan-la swazir enn mesaz. AAC pa zis enn seri kart. Demann ansegnan-la, fami-la ek, si ena enn ladan, spesialis ki ed zanfan-la avek laparol ek langaz kouma so fason abitie pou kominike marse. Gard li disponib kan zanfan-la boulverse; pa ranplas li avek enn nouvo kart ni demann zanfan-la koze avan ou ede.

Met zot dakor lor seki bann adilt fer kan zanfan-la demande. “Led” kapav vedir ouver kouver so bwat manze pou li kapav manze. “Poz” kapav vedir aret aktivite-la enn moman ek asiz pre ansam. Met zot dakor lor kisannla vey group-la. Si sez abitie-la okipe, propoz enn lot plas sir avek led enn adilt.

Pandan enn zwe kot zanfan-la alez, montre kouma demann enn koleg ouver enn bwat plastik avek enn kouver, kot enn adilt finn met enn zwe pou fer demonstrasion. Servi sign ouswa zimaz led ki zanfan-la kone, ek fer koleg-la ouver bwat-la deswit. Parti 5 donn lexanp-la an antie. Dan enn vre difikilte, reponn mem si zanfan-la servi enn lot zes ouswa li ankor pe plore. Demann led pa bizin vinn enn lot test.
Enn lexanp: enn lot adilt kot laport

Priya, de an, zwenn enn lot adilt kan li arive. Li kol ar dimounn ki akonpagn li ek detourn li. Adilt-la verifye routinn ki finn dakor avek fami-la: “Enn lot gran dimounn zordi. Nou kapav gete avan.” Li montre prosenn aktivite ki Priya kone.
Priya pous lame ki adilt-la propoze. Adilt-la arete: “Mo pou donn twa lespas. Mo pre.” Enn koleg dakor pou vey group-la. Personel pa pres li ek pa promet enn adilt ki pa disponib.

Pli tar, lekip-la ek fami-la prepar enn fason abitie pou dir orevwar ek fer Priya konn enn adilt ki kapav pran rele pandan enn zwe ordiner. Enn nouvo leson lor lemosion pa ti pou rezourd sanzman ki li pa ti atann kot laport.
Aster, esey oumem
Pratik ou bann premie mo, montre enn zimaz ouswa lobze ki li kone, apre atann.
Imazinn ki Priya refiz ou lame. Montre kouma ou aret kontak-la ek res disponib.
Demann enn koleg vey group-la ek atann so lakor. Propoz enn fason pou fer Priya konn adilt ki pran rele la pli tar.
Verifye ou repons

Eski ou finn rann sitiasion-la pli fasil, aksepte enn repons san laparol ek respekte “pa tous mwa”? Demann ansegnan-la ouswa fami-la atraver bann dispozision lekol si plan larive-la pa kler. Azout led pratik ar bann bon parol.

modules.title: Gard tou dimounn an sekirite, apre retrouv enn bon lien

blocks.text: Seki ou pou pratike
Kone kan sekirite, premie sekour ouswa proteksion zanfan bizin pas avan enn leson.
Demann enn lot adilt enn led kler ek ed enn zanfan apre ki danze-la finn pase.
Gagn bon led deswit

Si enn zanfan kapav bles limem ouswa lezot gravman, swiv bann letap sekirite lekol deswit. Apel personel forme ki finn deziye. Kontign vey tou dimounn; elwagn lezot zanfan ouswa bann zafer danzere kan li sir pou fer sa. Servi bann mo kourt ki pa menas li. Evit antour ouswa kwins zanfan-la. Kontign get seki pe pase.

Difikilte pou respire, perdi konesans, enn blesir grav ouswa enn lot posib ka medikal irzan bizin premie sekour ek bann letap irzans deswit, inklir bann servis dirzans lokal kan neseser. Pa atann enn lexersis pou kalme ouswa enn paran vinn sers zanfan-la.

Sa formasion-la pa ansegn ni otoriz restriksion fizik, setadir anpes enn dimounn bouze, ouswa izolman, setadir gard enn dimounn tousel kot li pa kapav sorti. Pa invant ni kopie bann teknik pou tini enn zanfan. Swiv lalwa, bann letap lekol ek bann limit ou formasion.
Apre ki danze-la finn pase, kontign ede

Verifye bann blesir, rekonfor ek swen neseser. Res disponib. Zanfan-la kapav ankor fatige ouswa pa kapav reponn. Get si so lintere abitie dan zwe pe retourne; silans ouswa enn sourir tousel pa prouve ki li pare pou koze. Li kapav bizin plis led ankor.
Depi 12 mwa ziska avan 18 mwa: redonn rekonfor ek swen. Propoz enn zwe ki li kone kan so lintere retourne. Reponn bann sign ouswa son; pa atann enn explikasion.

Depi 18 mwa ziska avan 3 an: propoz ou prezans ek enn letap fasil pou rant dan enn zwe ki li kone. Par exanp, si enn gran loto zwe roul anba enn latab, reponn kan zanfan-la montre li avek ledwa ek repran li dan enn fason sir. Pli tar, pandan enn zwe kot li alez, montre kouma montre loto-la avek ledwa ek dir “Led”. Pa met zwe enn zanfan kot li pa kapav atrap li pou kree enn problem zis pou pratike.
3–6 an: propoz li gete ouswa enn ti travay: “To kapav asiz akote mwa, ouswa ed met enn tas.” Koz lor seki finn ede pli tar, si zanfan-la kapav partisip dan sa konversasion-la.

Gard led disponib apre ki li revinn partisipe. Enn pardon, enn lexersis respirasion ouswa nom enn lemosion pa obligatwar. Okip separeman dimounn ki finn blese ouswa gagn per; li pa oblize aksepte bann kallin ouswa rekonfort zanfan ki finn fer li ditor.
Enn lexersis respirasion dous ki zanfan-la kapav swazir: seki adilt-la fer

Isi, enn lexersis respirasion vedir pratik enn souf ki rantre ek sorti dousman avek enn adilt pandan enn ti moman, san fors li. Se enn aktivite ki enn zanfan preskoler 3–6 an kapav swazir kan li poze, alez ek interese. Li pa enn tretman ni enn letap obligatwar apre enn moman difisil. Verifye so plan abitie pou led ek lasante; pa servi enn lexersis si li ena difikilte pou respire ouswa enn lot inkietid lasante.

1. Swazir enn moman fasil kot pena boukou tapaz. Asiz alez pre li ek demande: “To anvi get mwa pran enn souf dousman, ouswa esey avek mwa?” Aksepte enn zes ouswa bann mo. Si zanfan-la dir non ouswa detourn li, aret propoz lexersis-la.

2. Montre enn souf ordiner ki rantre san fors li, apre les li sorti dousman, dan enn ritm ki alez. Dir: “Rantre dousman … sorti dousman.” Zanfan-la kapav gete ouswa eseye. Pa demann li pran enn souf bien profon, pa fors enn ritm pli lant, pa demann li tini so souf, ferm so lizie ouswa kontigne ziska enn sif presi.

3. Pran enn poz ek obzerve. Si zanfan-la alez ek anvi enn lot tour, propoz enn ankor. Arete si li dir non, paret pa alez ouswa so latet pe tourne. Kontign donn swen ek res disponib. Dan so plas, propoz mwins tapaz, plis lespas ouswa enn aktivite ki li kone. Si li ena difikilte pou respire, servi bann letap premie sekour ek ka irzan, pa plis pratik.
Enn lexanp: Anika kapav gete, eseye ouswa arete

Anika, kat an, poze akote enn adilt ek pe get enn liv zimaz dan enn kwin trankil. Adilt-la asiz pre ek demande: “To anvi get mwa pran enn souf dousman, ouswa esey avek mwa?” Anika fer wi avek so latet ek gete. Adilt-la montre enn souf ki rantre san fors li ek sorti dousman, ek dir: “Rantre dousman … sorti dousman.” Anika esey enn fwa. Kan adilt-la propoz enn lot tour, li fer non avek so latet. Adilt-la arete: “Fini. Nou kapav get liv-la.” Zot res ansam ek tourn paz-la.

Enn lot fwa, Anika kapav refiz mem sa lexersis ki li kone la. Personel kapav diminie tapaz pre li, propoz zot prezans ouswa donn li lespas pandan ki zot kontign veye ek gard led disponib. Pa dir ki enn zanfan pe refiz respire: li pe refiz enn lexersis ki finn propoze. Okenn zanfan pa bizin fer li pou gagn swen ouswa retourn zwe.
Pli tar, ed remet bann zafer an ord

Kan bann zanfan pare, ed avek enn ti reparasion: remet bann materyel dan enn fason sir, verifye si enn dimounn bien ouswa pratik enn fason pli sir pou demande. “Enn dimounn pe okip Arun. Nou kapav ed rekonstrir kan tou dimounn pare.” Pa fors enn pardon.

Dan enn dosie sir, ekrir seki finn pase, seki bann adilt finn fer, bann blesir ouswa premie sekour ek seki finn ede. Gard bann sipozision separe. Swiv bann reg lekol pou averti bann responsab ek bann fami; protez lidantite lezot zanfan. Reget seki bann adilt kapav sanze, kouma averti avan enn zwe fini.
Bann inkietid lor proteksion zanfan bizin zot prop repons

Proteksion zanfan vedir protez bann zanfan kont ditor, inklir maltretans ek neglizans. Si ou remark enn posib ditor ouswa enn adilt pe azir dan enn fason danzere, swiv bann letap proteksion zanfan san tarde. Pa fer ou prop lanket ek pa atann enn revizion plan konportman. Servi led irzan osi si ena enn danze imedia.
Enn lexanp: Ben lev enn sez
Ben, sink an, boulverse apre ki enn zwe fini ek li lev enn sez pre lezot zanfan. Enn lot adilt la. Sekirite pas an premie, pa enn leson lor lemosion.

Personel servi bann letap pou led irzan. Enn koleg dakor pou rod led forme ek fer group-la al dan enn plas sir. Bann mo kourt kapav: “Mo la. Bann dimounn bizin lespas.” Bann aksion sir depann lor lasal-la ek bann letap aktiel lekol, pa zis sa bann mo-la.

Apre ki danze ek bann swen neseser finn okipe, personel propoz enn aktivite ki Ben kone avek led. Pli tar, zot pratik enn sign led ek reget kouma prepar Ben pou lafin bann zwe. Vinn trankil pa vedir ki bann letap sekirite finn fini.
Aktivite ekri: ed Lina apre enn zwe ki fer tapaz

Enn nouvo sitiasion ki finn invante: latour blok Lina, kat an, tonbe kan de zanfan galoup akote. Zot ankor pe galoupe parmi bann blok. Lina plore ek pous lame ki ou pe propoz li. Enn koleg akote group-la. Pli tar, apre ki plas-la an sekirite ek bann swen neseser finn verifye, Lina montre enn liv avek ledwa me fer non avek so latet kan ou propoz lexersis respirasion dous ki li finn deza eseye. Ekrir ou repons avan ou ouver repons propoze-la.

1. Ki ou pou fer an premie pou rann plas-la pli sir, ek ki travay kler ou pou demann koleg-la fer? Servi bann letap sekirite ki lekol deza ena si neseser. Pa zwe enn senn kot bann zanfan pe galoupe ek pa pratik bann teknik fizik.
2. Ki ou pou dir ek fer kan Lina pous ou lame? Inklir enn verifikasion pou bann blesir ouswa swen neseser, ek servi bann letap premie sekour lekol si bizin.
3. Kouma ou pou reponn kan Lina refiz lexersis respirasion-la ek montre liv-la avek ledwa? Dir kouma ou pou ed li retourn dan enn aktivite ki li kone kan li pare.
4. Ki ou kapav pratik pli tar dan enn zwe kot li alez, ek ki bann adilt pou sanze avan prosenn zwe kot bann zanfan galoupe?
Enn repons propoze: enn fason pou reponn

Demann koleg-la aret zwe kot bann zanfan pe galoupe ek gid group-la ver enn plas pou zwe kot pena bann zafer dan sime. Atann so lakor. Res disponib pou Lina, aret kontak ki ou ti pe propoze ek dir: “Mo pou donn twa lespas. Mo la.” Verifye si enn dimounn finn blese ek donn ouswa rod swen neseser; apel led forme irzan si ena enn danze grav. Enn fwa ki plas-la an sekirite, swiv seki Lina montre: “Nou kapav get liv-la.” Aret propoz lexersis-la ek asiz pre si li anvi ou prezans. Pli tar, montre kouma demann led pou rekonstrir, san demann enn pardon avan. Met zot dakor avek ansegnan-la kouma gard bann zwe kot bann zanfan galoupe lwin ar plas bann blok. Swiv bann letap lekol pou anrezistre ek raporte; sa formasion-la pa otoriz enn intervansion fizik.

modules.title: Ansegn bann ti aksion dan bann zwe toulezour

blocks.text: Seki ou pou pratike
Montre enn aksion itil pandan enn zwe, apre ed zanfan-la servi li dan enn vre routinn.
Rann zwe-la pli fasil ouswa arete kan zanfan-la montre ki li bizin enn sanzman.
Montre kouma demann led marse

Servi enn bwat plastik avek enn kouver ek enn gran loto zwe ki an sekirite pou laz zanfan-la, ki finn met apar pou demonstrasion bann adilt. Gard kouver-la fasil pou enn adilt ouver. Pandan enn zwe kot zanfan-la alez, enn adilt met loto zwe-la dan bwat-la ek dir: “Mo anvi tir loto-la. Eski to kapav ed mwa ouver kouver-la?” Li servi sign ouswa zimaz led ki zanfan-la deza kone pandan ki li demann enn koleg. Koleg-la ouver bwat-la deswit ek donn li loto-la. Zanfan-la kapav gete, partisipe ouswa kit aktivite-la. Sa montre exakteman ki led enn dimounn gagne kan li demande.

Demann ansegnan-la, fami-la ek, si ena enn ladan, spesialis ki ed zanfan-la avek laparol ek langaz ki bann mo, zes, sign, zimaz ouswa laparey zanfan-la deza servi. Servi sa fason abitie-la olye azout enn nouvo kart pou kominike san konsey.

Servi bwat ek zwe demonstrasion bann adilt. Pa ser kouver bwat enn zanfan, pa kasiet enn zwe ki li pe servi ek pa kree enn fristrasion pou fer li demann led. Pa zame fer li atann pou manze, swen ouswa led neseser zis pou pratike.
Propoz li gete, fer ansam ouswa pran enn tour avek bwat demonstrasion-la. Rann li pli fasil ouswa arete si zanfan-la pa alez. Pa bouz so bann lame pou fors li fer enn sign.
Kan enn vre bezwen led arive, reponn deswit. Ou kapav dir: “To finn pas mwa to bwat manze. Mo pou ouver kouver-la.” Zanfan-la pa bizin kopie enn sign ouswa servi enn zimaz avan.
Met zimaz ouswa laparey ki li kone kot zanfan-la bizin li, avek enn adilt pare pou reponn. Ede mem si zanfan-la servi enn lot sign ki ou konpran.

Enn fwa ki zanfan-la konn sa fason demann led la, montre li avek enn lot bwat demonstrasion fasil pou ouver ouswa enn lot adilt ki li kone. Gard led disponib; pa rann travay-la pli difisil pou teste zanfan-la.
Avan plis pratik, verifye: eski zanfan-la ti kapav atrap ek konpran zimaz-la, ek eski enn adilt finn reponn? Plis demann led kapav enn progre. Mwins larm tousel pa montre ki li alez.
Trwa lexanp zwe sinp

Swazir bann materyel sir pou laz ek bann bezwen mouvman zanfan-la, verifye bann risk toufe ek veye. Li gagn drwa gete ouswa arete. Sa bann zwe-la donn enn lokazion pratike; zot pa bann tretman ni bann test.

Depi 12 mwa ziska avan 18 mwa: swiv so lintere dan enn gran zwe ki an sekirite pou so laz. Kopie ouswa nom enn aksion; atann enn son, enn mouvman ouswa enn sign. Kontigne si li interese; arete si li detourn li ouswa li paret pa alez. Pa demann get dan lizie, pa kouver so figir ek pa obliz bann tour fixe.

Depi 18 mwa ziska avan 3 an: montre enn mouvman, apre kopie so mouvman. Zanfan-la kapav res asize, bouz so lame ouswa bouz enn gran zwe. Azout enn lot aksion zis si li agreab. Swiv si li sanz zwe-la ouswa arete si li perdi lintere. Esey sign ki li kone pli tar dan enn routinn fasil.

3–6 an: servi de marionet ek de loto zwe. Enn marionet pe zwe avek enn loto; lot-la demann sa mem loto-la. Montre adilt-la ed deziem marionet-la trouv loto anplis-la. Invit bann zanfan propoz enn lot lafin avek bann mo ouswa zes. Zot kapav gete ouswa arete. Pa pran zwe enn zanfan ni obliz partaze, kontak fizik ouswa lafeksion pou zwe zistwar-la.
Koz lor bann lemosion san fer enn test ar zanfan-la

Demann lor enn zistwar ouswa enn marionet: “Ki li kapav santi? Ki kapav ede?” Plizier repons ouswa “Mo pa sir” kapav al avek sa. Bann figir donn bann lindis, pa bann repons sertin. Gard bann lemosion prive: pa afis nom bann zanfan boulverse ouswa bann foto bann moman difisil. Bann pli tipti bizin zwe kot enn adilt reponn zot ek swen, plito ki enn leson lor lemosion.
Enn lexanp: kart led Sofia dan enn tirwar

Sofia, kat an, servi enn kart led ki li kone pandan enn zwe kot li alez. Kan ler pou manz enn ti zafer, li pa kapav ouver kouver so bwat manze, kot so manze ete. Li plore ek pous bwat manze-la. Kart-la ankor dan enn tirwar.

Adilt-la reponn aster: “Kouver-la finn bloke. Mo kapav ede.” Li ouver bwat manze Sofia deswit pou li kapav manze; li pa atann al sers kart-la. Pli tar, pandan enn zwe kot Sofia alez, de adilt montre kouma demann led avek zot bwat demonstrasion ek loto zwe, kouma finn dekrir lor paz avan. Enn adilt demande ek koleg-la ouver kouver-la. Sofia kapav gete ouswa partisipe san presion.

Prosenn fwa kan ler pou manz enn ti zafer, personel met kart led ki Sofia kone kot li kapav atrap li ek met zot dakor lor kisannla reponn. Pas bwat manze-la ouswa montre avek ledwa konte osi. Montre enn adilt ranplasan ki konn Sofia kouma reponn. Verifye si Sofia gagn led pou manze ek paret alez, pa zis si li aret plore.
Aster, esey oumem

Dir ek montre kouma ou ti pou ed Sofia ouver so bwat manze aster. Apre, servi enn bwat demonstrasion bann adilt avek enn kouver fasil pou ouver ek enn gran loto zwe pou montre fason demann led ki li kone. Fer enn koleg ouver li deswit. Manze ek bann zwe Sofia res disponib; pa kree enn difikilte pou li rezourd.
Montre kot kart ki li kone ti pou ete kan ler manze ek explik routinn-la enn adilt ranplasan.
Imazinn ki Sofia pous kart-la. Montre enn lot fason pou konpran so demann ek kontign ede.
Verifye ou repons

Eski led ti res disponib san enn repons korek avek kart-la? Eski kart-la ti kot Sofia ti bizin li? Eski enn adilt ti reponn? Demann ansegnan-la si fason kominike-la pa kler ouswa bann pratik kontign rann zanfan-la malere. Servi bann dosie aprouve lekol pou bann vre obzervasion; pa rant okenn detay zanfan isi.
Seki ou pou pratike
Ekrir seki ou finn trouve separeman ar seki ou krwar sa kapav vedir.
Met zot dakor lor seki bann adilt pou sanze, kisannla pou ede ek kan pou demann plis konsey.
Koumans avek seki bann fami kone

Enn zanfan kapav kontan sante lakaz me gagn difikilte dan klas. Toulede kapav vre. Servi lang ki fami-la prefere ek bann dispozision lekol pou kominike. Partaz enn zafer ki zanfan-la fer bien, seki ou finn trouve ek seki personel pou eseye. Demann seki ede lakaz; pa blam personn.
Enn lexanp obzervasion: Leo kan ler ranze

Seki finn pase: sis zanfan finn ariv kot bann letazer pandan ki bann sez ti pe bouze. Leo finn kouver so zorey, rekile ek asize. Li finn detourn li kan adilt-la poz bann kestion. Adilt-la finn aret koze ek fer group-la avanse. Avek enn adilt pre, Leo finn montre laport ek mars ziska plas pli trankil pou atann.

Bann explikasion posib: tapaz, lafoul ouswa enn prosenn letap ki pa kler kapav finn rann ler ranze difisil. Leo kapav ti ena enn lot bezwen. Sa se bann posibilite, pa enn diagnostik ni enn prev lakoz.

Seki pou eseye: mwins zanfan kot bann letazer, mwins tapaz bann sez ek enn panye ouswa zimaz ki li kone pou prosenn letap. Demande ki so bann sign vedir. Verifye seki bann adilt finn fer, si Leo paret alez ek si li kapav al dan prosenn aktivite. Enn sel pli bon lazourne pa prouve enn lakoz.
Enn lexanp plan: prosenn ler ranze Leo
Enn pwin for: Leo kontan tri bann gran blok avek enn adilt. So fami dir ki montre enn panye avek ledwa ede. Nou anvi ki ler ranze pli alez ek ki li ena enn fason pou demann led ouswa enn poz.

Avan: responsab group-la anvway mwins zanfan kot bann letazer ek evit tapaz bann sez. Adilt ki ed Leo montre panye-la: “Enn blok isi,” apre prosenn aktivite-la. Gard sign ouswa zimaz led ki li kone disponib.

Pandan: si Leo kouver so zorey ouswa rekile, diminie parol ek lafoul: “Nou kapav atann isi.” Res ansam dan plas sir ki finn dakor ouswa dan enn lot plas sir. Kontign veye; servi bann letap sekirite ouswa ka irzan si bizin.
Apre: propoz enn blok ansam, gete ouswa prosenn aktivite-la. Gard led disponib. Dan enn zwe pli tar, montre sign led-la ek repons adilt-la. Pa repet tapaz-la pou teste li.

Bann rol: responsab group-la sanz ler ranze; adilt ki ed Leo res avek li. Ansegnan-la deziyn enn ranplasan. Kan zot pas rele, partaz seki finn pase, seki finn ede ek kisannla vey sak group. Atann lakor-la.

Revizion: manb personel ki responsab Leo ek so fami met zot dakor kan pou konpar zot bann not, petet apre enn semenn, pli boner si ena enn inkietid. Eski bann adilt finn fer bann sanzman? Eski Leo ti kapav demann led ek profit bann aktivite alez? Koriz bann letap ki bann adilt finn rate avan ou ziz plan-la. Res trankil ek met li apar pa enn reisit.
Kone kan pou demann plis led
Si bann ti sanzman toulezour ede, kontign verifye avek zanfan-la, fami-la ek ansegnan-la. Pa kont zis kantite insidan.

Si bann moman difisil kontigne, ogmante, anpes zanfan-la partisipe ouswa kree bann risk sekirite souvan, demann ansegnan-la ouswa responsab inklizion, ki organiz led anplis, konsey. Partaz seki ou finn trouve ek eseye. Pa bizin enn diagnostik ni atann enn kantite letan fixe.

Si ena enn sanzman enn kout, enn posib douler ouswa maladi, ouswa zanfan-la nepli kapav fer enn zafer ki li ti abitie fer, servi kontak lasante lekol vit. Personel ed ek obzerve; bann profesionel kalifie fer bann evaliasion ek diagnostik.

Pou enn danze grav imedia ouswa enn posib ka medikal irzan, servi premie sekour ek bann letap dirzans aster. Pou enn posib maltretans, neglizans ouswa enn lot inkietid lor proteksion zanfan, swiv bann letap proteksion san tarde.

Inklir bann fami dan bann desizion ordiner lor led ek bann lezot servis, dapre bann reg lekol lor lakor ek lavi prive. Pa les bann letap lakor ordiner retard enn proteksion neseser. Servi bann dosie sir ki finn aprouve. Sa lexanp-la pa ranplas enn plan swen ouswa sekirite pou enn zanfan.
Enn lexanp: “Nou pa trouv sa lakaz”

Noah, sink an, souvan elwagn li kan enn gran group pe sante. So paran dir: “Li sant touletan lakaz.” Personel reponn: “Isi osi li kontan bann sante ki li swazir dan enn ti group. Dan gran group-la, li elwagn li ek parfwa li pa partisip dan sante. Kouma li sante lakaz?”

Avek lide fami-la, personel dakor pou esey enn plas pli trankil lor kote, avek enn adilt pre ek sign poz ki Noah kone. Ansegnan-la deziyn personel ek enn ranplasan. Zot met zot dakor kan pou gete si sanzman-la finn fer ek si Noah ti kapav demann led ek profit sante alez. Zot rod konsey pli boner si bann inkietid ogmante.
Aster, fer ou version
Pratik enn koumansman ki inklir enn pwin for, seki ou finn trouve ek enn kestion pou fami-la. Gard “tro boukou tapaz” kouma enn posibilite, pa enn fe sir.
Swazir enn sanzman ki enn adilt pou fer. Montre seki arive si Noah demann enn poz. Dir kisannla ede, kisannla pran rele ek kan zot reget plan-la.
Dir seki ou ti pou ekrir ek ki ti pou fer ou demann led pli boner.
Verifye ou repons

Plis demann poz kapav montre ki Noah pe kominike pli bien. Si li fer mwins tapaz me li pas plis letan tousel, sa kapav montre ki plan-la bizin sanze. Get si li alez, si li kapav kominike ek si li ena bann lokazion profit bann aktivite, ansam avek seki bann adilt finn vremem fer.

questions.q: Imani, 14 mwa, avans so lame ver enn adilt ki li kone kan li arive. De adilt koz ansam ek enn zwe mizikal koumanse. Li detourn li, pous zwe-la akote ek plengne. Li servi sirtou bann sign ek bann son ki li kone. Ki adilt-la bizin fer an premie?
options: Propoz enn lot zwe dous ek kontign esey gard so latansion.
Aret son anplis-la, propoz rekonfor ki li kone ek verifye ki swen ouswa led li bizin.
Montre de zimaz lemosion pou li swazir led ki li bizin.
Kontign sante ki li kone avan sanz kiksoz.
questions.why: Imani deza pe kominike. Diminie bann son, propoz rekonfor ki li kone ek verifye bann swen neseser. Get so repons avan propoz enn sel ti prosenn letap. Li pa bizin nom enn lemosion ouswa get ou avan ou ed li.

questions.q: Ki not separ bien seki personel finn trouve ar seki zot krwar kapav explik li?
options: Leo ti ena enn problem avek bann sansasion ek li ti bizin sove kan ler ranze.
Leo ti paret trakase, alor nou kone ki sante-la finn boulvers li.
Leo finn kouver so zorey kan bann sez ti pe bouze. Personel finn diminie tapaz. Bann son kapav enn zafer pou gete.
Leo finn fer pli bien parski li ti ena konfians dan program an zimaz.
questions.why: Not-la dekrir seki finn pase ek gard bann son kouma enn explikasion posib. Enn sel pli bon lazourne pa prouve kifer enn zafer finn arive.

questions.q: Ou lavwa pe vinn sek pandan ki enn zanfan boulverse. Ki ou bizin fer apre?
options: Pran enn poz, servi mwins mo ek demann enn lot adilt pran rele si bizin, an atann so lakor.
Dir zanfan-la ki li pe fer ou ankoler.
Ale deswit san dir enn lot adilt.
Fini konversasion-la avan demann led.
questions.why: Enn poz ek led enn koleg kapav ed ou reponn pli kalm. Fer sir ki enn lot adilt finn aksepte responsabilite-la dan enn fason kler avan ou ale; bann zanfan bizin kontign gagn sirveyans.

questions.q: Leo kouver so zorey ek rekile kan ena boukou dimounn pandan ler ranze. Ki plan pli bien verifye si sanz routinn-la ede?
options: Pratik enn zwe pou kalme sak gramatin me gard ler ranze parey.
Esey enn lot zouti sak zour ek note lekel fer li trankil pli vit.
Explik bann reg pou ranze dan enn leson trankil ek gete si li kapav repet zot.
Met mwins zanfan kot bann letazer, diminie tapaz bann sez ek verifye seki personel finn fer ek kouma Leo finn pase.
questions.why: Sa plan-la sanz tapaz ek lafoul ki personel finn remarke. Verifye si bann adilt finn fer sa bann sanzman-la ek si Leo ti kapav demann led ek rant dan prosenn aktivite alez.

questions.q: Akoz lapli, zwe dan zardin pou vinn enn zwe kot bouze andan. Zanfan-la deza konpran bann zimaz aster ek apre. Ki adilt-la bizin fer?
options: Les zimaz zardin-la ziska ler abitie pou sorti.
Montre zimaz vre nouvo aktivite-la, explik enn tigit ek montre enn prosenn letap fasil.
Demann zanfan-la nom toulede zimaz avan sanz zot.
Montre tou bann aktivite posib ek demann zanfan-la devinn plan-la.
questions.why: Bann zimaz bizin montre seki pou vremem arive. Montre sanzman-la ek kot pou ale. Konpran nouvo plan-la pa vedir ki zanfan-la oblize aret santi li desi.

questions.q: Ki fason servi enn plas pli trankil ede?
options: Enn plas kot enn adilt kapav ed zanfan-la, kontign vey li ek ed li retourn zwe.
Enn pinision apre ki li pa finn swiv enn reg.
Enn lasal kot zanfan-la pa kapav sorti ziska li demann pardon.
Enn plas pou les bann zanfan boulverse tousel pou aprann debrouy zot.
questions.why: Plas-la donn rekonfor ek led. Li pa bizin vinn enn pinision, enn fason les zanfan-la tousel ouswa enn test ki li bizin pase avan sorti.

questions.q: Apre enn larive bien okipe, enn zanfan ki abitie koz boukou res asize san bouze ek san koze dan enn fason ki pa abitie pou li. Ki adilt-la bizin fer?
options: Felisit li parski so lekor trankil ek amenn li direk dan aktivite prevwar-la.
Koumans enn diskision lor lemosion parski lasal-la pli trankil.
Al gete san kole ar li, servi so fason abitie pou kominike ek get bann sign ki abitie montre ki li alez.
Ansegn enn nouvo zwe respirasion parski zanfan-la trankil.
questions.why: Silans tousel pa montre ki enn zanfan alez ouswa pare pou aprann. Servi kominikasion ki li kone, rann bann zafer pli fasil ek verifye ki led li bizin.

questions.q: Priya, de an, detourn li ek pous lame ki enn adilt propoze kan li arive. Pena danze imedia. Ki adilt-la bizin fer?
options: Donn li lespas, res pre avek enn tigit mo ek swiv routinn larive ki li kone.
Propoz enn kallin dan plas enn lame.
Explik kifer li kapav fer adilt-la konfians, apre repropoz lame-la.
Montre plizier nouvo kart pou kalme pou Priya swazir.
questions.why: Priya kapav refiz kontak ek ankor bizin enn dimounn pre. Aret kontak-la, res disponib ek kontign donn swen ek veye.

questions.q: Enn zanfan kat an finn deza esey enn lexersis ki li kapav swazir: pran enn souf ki rantre san fors li ek les li sorti dousman avek enn adilt. Zordi, li fer non avek so latet kan ou propoz li sa. Ki ou bizin fer?
options: Repet linstriksion-la ziska zanfan-la fer li.
Tir so led pou kominike.
Explik ki sa lexersis respirasion-la se sel fason pou kalme.
Aret propoz lexersis-la, diminie tapaz ouswa presion ek propoz ou prezans, lespas ouswa enn lot led ki li kone.
questions.why: Zanfan-la pe refiz enn lexersis, li pa pe refiz respire kouma abitie. Aksepte so “non”, kontign donn swen ek veye, ek propoz enn led ki al avek li aster. Lexersis-la pa zame obligatwar avan rekonfor, manze ouswa retourn zwe.

questions.q: Enn zanfan riske bles enn dimounn gravman deswit. Ki pas an premie?
options: Fini bann kestion refleksion.
Servi bann letap sekirite lekol, apel led forme ki finn dakor ek protez lezot pandan ki tou dimounn kontign gagn sirveyans.
Gagn enn explikasion oral konplet ar zanfan-la.
Esey enn teknik pou tini li ki ou finn trouv lor internet.
questions.why: ESANSIEL POU SEKIRITE: protez bann dimounn ek gagn led dapre plan sekirite lekol deswit. Sa formasion-la pa ansegn ni otoriz bann teknik intervansion fizik.

questions.q: Enn zanfan boulverse gagn difikilte pou respire ouswa perdi konesans. Ki personel bizin fer?
options: Esey bann mo pou kalme pandan plizier minit avan.
Atann enn manb fami arive.
Servi bann letap premie sekour ek ka irzan, inklir bann servis dirzans lokal kan neseser.
Konsider sa kouma enn difikilte ordiner pou zer bann lemosion.
questions.why: ESANSIEL POU SEKIRITE: enn posib ka medikal irzan bizin led forme ek bann aksion irzan. Pa retard sa pou esey enn fason kalme.

questions.q: Ki sa formasion-la permet ou fer lor restriksion fizik ouswa izolman, setadir anpes enn dimounn bouze ouswa gard li tousel kot li pa kapav sorti?
options: Servi toulede si ou gagn enn bon rezilta dan kestioner-la.
Servi nenport teknik ki apel ko-regilasion.
Servi bann teknik apre get enn video demonstrasion.
Li pa donn okenn lotorizasion ni teknik. Pa improvize; swiv lalwa, bann letap lekol ek bann limit ou formasion.
questions.why: ESANSIEL POU SEKIRITE: fini sa formasion-la pa enn formasion lor intervansion fizik. Servi repons ki lekol finn dakor ek led bann dimounn ki ena bon formasion.

questions.q: Danze imedia dan insidan Ben finn pase. Li trankil me li detourn li kan ou poz bann kestion. Ki bizin arive aster?
options: Explik reg-la avan li bliye seki finn pase.
Verifye bann blesir ek swen neseser, res disponib ek propoz enn retour fasil ver zwe; ansegne ek ed repar pli tar.
Demann li swazir enn zimaz lemosion pou prouve ki li pare pou retourne.
Pratik enn lot repons deswit parski danze-la finn pase.
questions.why: Lafin danze-la pa vedir Ben pare pou koze ouswa aprann. Redonn rekonfor ek ed li retourne kan li pare. Enn explikasion ouswa enn pardon pa enn kondisyon pou partisip ankor.

questions.q: Sofia servi enn sign ouswa zimaz led ki li kone pandan enn zwe kot li alez. Kan ler pou manz enn ti zafer, li pa kapav ouver so bwat manze ek pous li ver enn adilt. Kouma personel kapav ede aster ek rann demann-la pli fasil prosenn fwa?
options: Repet leson-la ziska li servi li tousel avan resey ler manze.
Donn li plizier nouvo zimaz led pou swazir kan li boulverse.
Ouver bwat manze-la aster, gard zimaz ki li kone kot li kapav atrap li ek fer sir ki bann adilt rekonet ek reponn so bann sign ouswa zes.
Gard ler manze lor latab leson pou touletan pou li pa bizin servi sign-la lezot plas.
questions.why: Sofia deza pe demande atraver so aksion. Ed li ouver so bwat manze pou li kapav manze. Gard so fason abitie pou kominike disponib kan ler manze, ek montre enn adilt ranplasan kouma reponn. Pli tar, bann adilt kapav montre demann led-la avek enn bwat zwe apar; pa zame retard manze pou pratike.

questions.q: Enn zanfan servi sirtou bann sign plito ki laparol. Ki konte kouma enn demann led?
options: Zis enn fraz oral konplet.
Enn zes, zimaz, sign ouswa enn lot fason ki zanfan-la kone, kapav servi ek ki personel konpran.
Zis fason ki laplipar bann zanfan servi.
Nanye ziska zanfan-la gagn enn diagnostik.
questions.why: Bann mo pa sel fason pou demande. Servi fason kominike ki zanfan-la kone ek demann ansegnan-la ki bann sign, zimaz ouswa laparey pou soutenir.

questions.q: Ena mwins insidan avek boukou tapaz, me zanfan-la pas plis letan tousel ek rarman partisip dan bann zwe ki li kontan. Ki personel bizin regete?
options: Nanye: mwins insidan avek tapaz montre ki plan-la marse.
Kouma ogmant letan trankil san led adilt.
Zis komie letan sak insidan dire.
Si zanfan-la alez, so kominikasion, led bann adilt ek so bann lokazion profit bann aktivite, ansam avek zanfan-la ek so fami.
questions.why: Enn lasal pli trankil pa ase pou prouve ki zanfan-la pe al bien. Verifye si personel finn fer bann sanzman prevwar ek si zanfan-la santi li alez ek kapav partisipe.

questions.q: Enn paran dir ki li pa trouv mem difikilte lakaz. Ki repons pli itil?
options: Konpar seki pase lakaz ek lekol, an partaz bann obzervasion kler avek respe.
Dir ki enn parmi sa de rakontaz-la bizin fos.
Konklir ki zanfan-la pe fer sanblan dan lekol.
Aret led ziska fami-la dakor avek personel.
questions.why: Lakaz ek lekol kapav demann diferan zafer ar enn zanfan. Toulede rakontaz kapav vre ek ed personel fer enn meyer plan.

questions.q: Ou remark enn zafer ki fer ou trakase pou proteksion enn zanfan. Ki ou bizin fer?
options: Atann ki zot finn esey enn plan konportman pandan enn mwa.
Demann zanfan-la rakont seki finn pase devan tou personel.
Swiv bann letap proteksion zanfan san tarde; servi led irzan si ena enn danze imedia.
Sipoze ki sa zis enn difikilte pou zer bann lemosion.
questions.why: ESANSIEL POU SEKIRITE: enn posib maltretans, neglizans ouswa enn lot ditor bizin bann letap proteksion zanfan. Pa tret sa zis kouma enn konportman pou zere. Signal vit ek servi bann dosie aprouve.

questions.q: Plan Leo pa finn fer boukou diferans, me personel souvan finn bliye zimaz-la ek anvway tou dimounn kot letazer-la ansam. Ki bizin arive apre?
options: Swazir enn nouvo zouti pou kalme parski plan-la pa finn marse.
Rann bann letap adilt fasil pou fer ek fer zot regilierman, verifye si zot pe arive ek kouma Leo pe pase, ek rod konsey pli boner si ena enn inkietid.
Donn Leo plis pratik pou ranze tousel pou ranplas bann letap ki bann adilt finn rate.
Atann enn kantite insidan fixe avan demann enn dimounn konsey.
questions.why: Ou pa kapav ziz enn plan dan enn fason zis si led ki finn dakor ti manke. Koriz bann letap adilt ek verifye si Leo alez ek kapav kominike. Pa retard bann konsey neseser pou lasante, led anplis, sekirite ouswa proteksion zanfan.

questions.q: Bann difikilte kontigne malgre bann sanzman ki finn bien reflesi. Ki enn bon prosenn letap?
options: Servi enn lalis lor internet pou fer enn diagnostik lakoz.
Promet fami-la ki sa formasion-la pou geri sa.
Aret led ordiner ziska enn diagnostik arive.
Rod konsey atraver bann kontak lekol pou led anplis ouswa lasante avek fami-la, pandan ki ou kontign donn led sir ek get kouma zanfan-la pe ale.
questions.why: Personel ed ek obzerve; bann profesionel kalifie fer bann evaliasion ek diagnostik. Demann konsey atraver bon kontak lekol pandan ki ou gard bann led toulezour ki itil.

blocks.text: Pou bann ansegnan, asistan ek personel ki ed bann zanfan depi 12 mwa ziska 6 an. Bann group pou prepare se 12 mwa ziska avan 18 mwa, 18 mwa ziska avan 3 an, ek 3–6 an, bann zanfan sis an osi. Sa pa bann test lor seki enn zanfan sipoze fer. Swiv so plan, so fason kominike ek so bann bezwen aster, dan bann limit ou rol. Sa formasion-la pa ansegn kouma port, nouri ouswa fer dormi enn zanfan.

Sa resours-la finn prepare pou travay dan Inspired ELS. Li pa enn reg Inspired finn aprouve, enn kalifikasion medikal, enn formasion proteksion zanfan ouswa enn formasion intervansion fizik. Swiv bann letap aktiel lekol pou proteksion zanfan, inklizion, premie sekour ek bann ka irzan, ansam avek lalwa lokal. Enn dosie fin formasion montre zis laprantisaz an-lign.

Prevwar anviron 75 minit: sis parti 10 minit (60 minit), 12 minit pou kestioner final ek 3 minit pou bann deklarasion responsabilite ek fini. Letan sak parti inklir lektir, enn ti pratik ek bann kestion rapid. Bann video opsionel, bann zouti, bann nouvo tantativ ek bann pratik an ekip pli tar pran plis letan. Sa enn estimasion, pa enn dosie prezans kronometre.

reference.title: Seki bann prev kapav dir nou

blocks.text: Bann resers ek konsey profesionel soutenir bann bon lien avek bann adilt bienveyan, bann lespas ek routinn pli fasil ek pratik bann ti aksion avek led. Bann prev pou bann metod presi pou tipti zanfan limite ek pa egal, sirtou pou bann pli zenn. Bann gid donn bann lide pratik; zot pa prouve ki sa bann fraz ouswa zwe presi-la marse. Sa formasion-la pa finn teste dan enn fason indepandan kouma enn tretman, ek okenn lorganizasion ki finn site pa finn aprouv li.

Gid bann sours explik seki sak referans soutenir ek so bann limit. Li separ bann konsey profesionel, bann materyel program ek bann resers. Sa formasion-la pa fer enn diagnostik lor leta servo, pa fixe bann lobzektif par dat laniverser ek pa promet ki enn lide pou touletan kalm enn zanfan. Enn kestioner pa kapav prouve bann kapasite pratik; servi bann konsey lekol, bann pratik avek sipervizion ek bann komanter fami.

reference.title: Lavi prive ek bann dosie formasion

blocks.text: Servi zis bann lexanp ki finn invante. Pa rant bann vre nom zanfan, diagnostik, linformasion fami ouswa dosie insidan. Ou progre ek bann detay adilt ki ou rant isi res dan sa navigater-la. Pena enn rezis santral ni enn servis imel otomatik. Gard bann vre dosie dan sistem sir lekol finn aprouve.
